preconditions.description: There must be at least two lines in the input.
Each action line must contain exactly four words.
Your name must be a non-empty string.
The number of actions must match the specified count.

postconditions.expression: all(name.islower() and 1 <= len(name) <= 10 for name in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output name must be a lowercase string of length between 1 and 10.
The output names must be sorted by priority factor in descending order, and alphabetically for ties.
Your name must not appear in the output.
